scope: Buildable host-shell contract only; native UI wiring remains behind this boundary.
notes: Implemented host shell: a native Win32 GDI window (windows-sys) that renders the pure, headless-testable model in src/model.rs and drives it through the Win32 message loop. WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK remains the target toolkit for the full product UI; the Win32 shell is the buildable Windows-first bootstrap behind this boundary.
